_meta.note: 10 real distinct beaches from the alias/section bucket; 4 nudist + Tzanaki(nudist) + 2 review deferred; Milos Rema excluded (deliberately removed). Renames: Στενό, Μεγάλη Άμμος.

beaches.verifyReason: Multiple tourism sources (Greeka, visit-halkidiki, gr-beaches) confirm Mykoniatika as a real 1.5km+ sandy Blue Flag organized swimming beach near Nea Kallikrateia, Halkidiki, Greece, distinct from the separately-named Anthoupoli beach 553m away.

OSM way 134453104 is tagged natural=beach/surface=sand named "Sfagia" at Panormos (Mylopotamos, Rethymno, Crete); multiple travel sites (Beachfarer, VRBO, Hotels.com, Expedia) independently index it as a real swimmable beach distinct from and ~253 m from our existing harbor-side "Λίμνη" (Limni) beach.

OSM way 1466111647 is tagged natural=beach connected to the coastline; "spiantza" is the local Paxos/Antipaxos word for a small cove/beach (per Greek Wikipedia "σπιάντζα Φύκι/Μεσαβρίκα"), so this is "the cove at Sfouggaria" on Antipaxos (Ionian Sea, Greece), sitting 407 m south of our Σαρακίνικο id 1043 and southernmost of all 13 Antipaxos entries — a genuinely distinct unorganized cove, not a bar/resort/duplicate/foreign feature.

Multiple independent Greek travel sources (lakonia.mobi, exploring-greece.gr, beachsearcher, inLaconia) describe Κάτω Μέζαπος as a real small pebble swimmable cove with crystalline waters in Mani, Lakonia (Peloponnese, Greece), and the lakonia.mobi page explicitly lists Χαλικιά (~0.4km, our way/257076538) as a separate nearby beach, confirming the candidate (OSM way/257076528) is a distinct beach we lack rather than a duplicate, bar, or foreign place.

Στενό is a well-documented organized sandy beach on the narrow isthmus of Astypalaia (TripAdvisor, astypalaia.gr, travel.gr, allovergreece), explicitly listed as separate from the nearby Μαμούνια beach.

"Στη Μεγάλη Άμμο" is the locative form of the well-documented sandy/pebbly Μεγάλη Άμμος beach on Alonissos's west coast (~6.5km N of Patitiri), listed separately on alonissos.gr, greeka.com and exploring-greece.gr; it is a distinct Greek public swimmable beach, different from our nearby rocky Στροβίλι (a separate cove with the Kastanorema gorge).

Σουτραλί Αγριάς has an official Greek government bathing-water profile (GRBW089105025) and is an organized swimmable beach near Volos, distinct from Καλαμιές which sources explicitly place "after Soutrali" (Agria→Soutrali→Kalamies chain).

OSM way 1109066282 is tagged natural=beach (lifeguard=no, supervised=no) on the actual coastline of southern Alonissos near Patitiri/Marpounta in Greece — not a bar/hotel/marina/foreign feature; it is a small undeveloped cove ~447 m from our nearest record Νικόλα Βάλα (39.141,23.867), a separate location and name, so it is a genuine distinct Greek swimmable cove we lack (note: thin secondary coverage, OSM-only, no Google place within 400 m).

OSM tags it natural=beach and travel sources (travel.gr, TripAdvisor, beach DBs) describe "Olive Beach/Olive Bay" near Horto-Milina, South Pelion as a swimmable pebble cove with turquoise water, explicitly distinct from nearby Vathia Spilia, in mainland Greece (Magnesia).

OSM way 462585721 is tagged natural=beach and multiple travel sources (Greeka, alonissos.gr) describe it as a small unorganized pebble beach at the edge of Patitiri harbour (Alonissos capital, Greece) with clear turquoise water, crowded with swimmers daily; it is a distinct named beach from "Νικόλα Βάλα" 391 m away, which is a separate coastal area near Steni Vala.
